cards.headline: Markets closed — Labor Day
cards.body: US equity markets are shut for Labor Day, so the tape is frozen at the previous session's close. Everything below reflects that last close — not live trading — and refreshes when the market reopens.

cards.headline: Last close: a broad bid, 58% of AI names green
cards.body: SPX -0.38% · BTC -1.40% · Gold +1.06% · Nasdaq100 +0.21%. At the last close, 58% of 101 AI names were green — a broad bid. Chip Equipment & AI Hardware did the heavy lifting at +4.33%.

cards.headline: Chip Equipment & AI Hardware leads, Applied AI: Industrial, Defense & Vertical lags
cards.body: Strongest AI sector is Chip Equipment & AI Hardware at +4.33%; weakest is Applied AI: Industrial, Defense & Vertical at -2.81%. Rotation within the AI trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: PATH is the standout at -16.52%
cards.body: Leaders: CBRS +10.47%, KLAC +7.33%, SKHY +6.95%, MRVL +6.49%, NRG +5.98%. Laggards: PATH -16.52%, ADBE -6.76%, TSLA -6.24%, WDAY -5.37%.

cards.headline: SpaceX (SPCX) -1.24% at $147.89
cards.body: The SpaceX debut keeps pulling attention — SPCX is -1.24% this session. The biggest IPO in history remains the tape's attention magnet.

cards.headline: Risk: AI bubble index 57 — Heating Up
cards.body: The composite AI Bubble Index sits at 57/100, led by Valuation at 85. Higher = frothier; the risk is everyone caring at once while valuations are already stretched.
